### TEMPLATE "_markup/render-blockquote.html" 1173
{{if eq .Type "alert"}}{{$alerts := dict "caution" (dict "color" "red" "icon" "exclamation-triangle") "important" (dict "color" "blue" "icon" "exclamation-circle") "note" (dict "color" "blue" "icon" "information-circle") "tip" (dict "color" "green" "icon" "light-bulb") "warning" (dict "color" "orange" "icon" "exclamation-triangle")}}{{$alertTypes := slice}}{{range $k, $_ := $alerts}}{{$alertTypes = $alertTypes | append $k}}{{end}}{{$alertTypes = $alertTypes | sort}}{{$alertType := strings.ToLower .AlertType}}{{if in $alertTypes $alertType}}{{partial "layouts/blocks/alert.html" (dict "color" (or ((index $alerts $alertType).color) "blue") "icon" (or ((index $alerts $alertType).icon) "information-circle") "text" .Text "title" .AlertTitle "class" .Attributes.class) | _html_template_htmlescaper}}{{else}}{{errorf `Invalid blockquote alert type. Received %s. Expected one of %s (case-insensitive). See %s.` .AlertType (delimit $alertTypes ", " ", or ") .Page.String | _html_template_htmlescaper}}{{end}}{{else}}
  <blockquote{{with .Attributes.class}}class="{{. | _html_template_attrescaper}}"{{end}}>
    {{.Text | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
  </blockquote>{{end}}

### TEMPLATE "_markup/render-codeblock.html" 1888


{{$copy := false}}{{$file := or .Attributes.file ""}}{{$details := false}}{{$open := ""}}{{$summary := or .Attributes.summary "Details" | .Page.RenderString}}{{$ext := strings.TrimPrefix "." (path.Ext $file)}}{{$lang := or .Type $ext "text"}}{{if in (slice "html" "gotmpl") $lang}}{{$lang = "go-html-template"}}{{end}}{{if eq $lang "md"}}{{$lang = "text"}}{{end}}{{with .Attributes.copy}}{{if in (slice true "true" 1) .}}{{$copy = true}}{{else}}{{if in (slice false "false" 0) .}}{{$copy = false}}{{end}}{{end}}{{end}}{{with .Attributes.details}}{{if in (slice true "true" 1) .}}{{$details = true}}{{else}}{{if in (slice false "false" 0) .}}{{$details = false}}{{end}}{{end}}{{end}}{{with .Attributes.open}}{{if in (slice true "true" 1) .}}{{$open = "open"}}{{else}}{{if in (slice false "false" 0) .}}{{$open = ""}}{{end}}{{end}}{{end}}{{if $details}}
  <details class="cursor-pointer" {{$open | _html_template_htmlnamefilter}}>
  <summary>{{$summary | _html_template_htmlescaper}}</summary>{{end}}

<div
  x-data
  class="render-hook-codeblock font-mono not-prose relative mt-6 mb-8 border-1 border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-800 bg-light dark:bg-dark">{{$fileSelectClass := "select-none"}}{{if $copy}}{{$fileSelectClass = "select-text"}}
    <svg
      class="absolute right-4 top-2 z-30 text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-500 dark:text-gray-400 dark:hover:text-gray-300 cursor-pointer w-6 h-6"
      @click="$copy($refs.code)">
      <use href="#icon--copy"></use>
    </svg>{{end}}{{with $file}}
    <div
      class="san-serif text-sm inline-block leading-none pl-2 py-3 bg-gray-300 dark:bg-slate-700 w-full {{$fileSelectClass | _html_template_attrescaper}}
">
      {{. | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
    </div>{{end}}

  <div x-ref="code">{{transform.Highlight (strings.TrimSpace .Inner) $lang .Options | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
  </div>
</div>{{if $details}}
  </details>{{end}}

### TEMPLATE "_markup/render-link.html" 3126
{{$renderHookName := "link"}}{{$minHugoVersion := "0.141.0"}}{{if lt hugo.Version $minHugoVersion}}{{errorf "The %q render hook requires Hugo v%s or later." $renderHookName $minHugoVersion | _html_template_htmlescaper}}{{end}}{{$errorLevel := or site.Params.render_hooks.link.errorLevel "ignore" | lower}}{{$highlightBrokenLinks := or site.Params.render_hooks.link.highlightBroken false}}{{if not (in (slice "ignore" "warning" "error") $errorLevel)}}{{errorf "The %q render hook is misconfigured. The errorLevel %q is invalid. Please check your site configuration." $renderHookName $errorLevel | _html_template_htmlescaper}}{{end}}{{$contentPath := .Page.String}}{{$u := urls.Parse .Destination}}{{$msg := printf "The %q render hook was unable to resolve the destination %q in %s" $renderHookName $u.String $contentPath}}{{$attrs := dict "href" $u.String}}{{if eq $u.String "g"}}{{$ctx := dict "contentPath" $contentPath "errorLevel" $errorLevel "renderHookName" $renderHookName "text" .Text}}{{$attrs = partial "inline/h-rh-l/get-glossary-link-attributes.html" $ctx}}{{else}}{{if $u.IsAbs}}{{$attrs = merge $attrs (dict "rel" "external")}}{{else}}{{with $u.Path}}{{with $p := or ($.PageInner.GetPage .) ($.PageInner.GetPage (strings.TrimRight "/" .))}}{{$href := .RelPermalink}}{{with $u.RawQuery}}{{$href = printf "%s?%s" $href .}}{{end}}{{with $u.Fragment}}{{$ctx := dict "contentPath" $contentPath "errorLevel" $errorLevel "page" $p "parsedURL" $u "renderHookName" $renderHookName}}{{partial "inline/h-rh-l/validate-fragment.html" $ctx | _html_template_htmlescaper}}{{$href = printf "%s#%s" $href .}}{{end}}{{$attrs = dict "href" $href}}{{else}}{{with $.PageInner.Resources.Get $u.Path}}{{$attrs = dict "href" .RelPermalink}}{{else}}{{with (and (ne $.Page.BundleType "leaf") ($.Page.CurrentSection.Resources.Get $u.Path))}}{{$attrs = dict "href" .RelPermalink}}{{else}}{{with resources.Get $u.Path}}{{$attrs = dict "href" .RelPermalink}}{{else}}{{if eq $errorLevel "warning"}}{{warnf $msg | _html_template_htmlescaper}}{{if and $highlightBrokenLinks hugo.IsDevelopment}}{{$attrs = merge $attrs (dict "class" "broken")}}{{end}}{{else}}{{if eq $errorLevel "error"}}{{errorf $msg | _html_template_htmlescaper}}{{end}}{{end}}{{end}}{{end}}{{end}}{{end}}{{else}}{{with $u.Fragment}}{{$ctx := dict "contentPath" $contentPath "errorLevel" $errorLevel "page" $.Page "parsedURL" $u "renderHookName" $renderHookName}}{{partial "inline/h-rh-l/validate-fragment.html" $ctx | _html_template_htmlescaper}}{{$attrs = dict "href" (printf "%s#%s" $.Page.RelPermalink .)}}{{else}}{{if eq $errorLevel "warning"}}{{warnf $msg | _html_template_htmlescaper}}{{if and $highlightBrokenLinks hugo.IsDevelopment}}{{$attrs = merge $attrs (dict "class" "broken")}}{{end}}{{else}}{{if eq $errorLevel "error"}}{{errorf $msg | _html_template_htmlescaper}}{{end}}{{end}}{{end}}{{end}}{{end}}{{end}}<a{{with .Title}}title="{{. | _html_template_attrescaper}}"{{end}}{{range $k, $v := $attrs}}{{if $v}}{{printf " %s=%q" $k ($v | transform.HTMLEscape) | safeHTMLAttr | _html_template_htmlnamefilter}}{{end}}{{end}}>{{.Text | _html_template_htmlescaper}}</a
>

### TEMPLATE "_partials/helpers/funcs/color-from-string.html" 724
{{$colors := slice "slate" "green" "cyan" "blue"}}
{{with .single}}
  {{$colors = slice .}}
{{end}}

{{$shades := slice 300 400 500}}
{{if not .dark}}
  {{$shades = slice 700 800}}
{{end}}
{{$hash := (hash.FNV32a .text)}}
{{$i := mod $hash (len $colors)}}
{{$j := mod $hash (len $shades)}}
{{$color := index $colors $i}}
{{$shade1 := index $shades $j}}
{{$shade2 := 0}}
{{$shade3 := 0}}
{{if gt $shade1 500}}
  {{$shade2 = math.Min (sub $shade1 500) 100 | int}}
  {{$shade3 = sub $shade1 100}}
{{else}}
  {{$shade2 = math.Max (add $shade1 500) 700 | int}}
  {{$shade3 = add $shade1 200}}
{{end}}
{{$res := dict "color" $color "shade1" $shade1 "shade2" $shade2 "shade3" $shade3}}
{{return $res | _html_template_htmlescaper}}

### TEMPLATE "_partials/helpers/funcs/get-github-info.html" 963
{{$url := "https://api.github.com/repos/gohugoio/hugo"}}
{{$cacheKey := print $url (now.Format "2006-01-02")}}
{{$headers := dict}}
{{with os.Getenv "HUGO_GH_TOKEN"}}
  {{$headers = dict "Authorization" (printf "Bearer %s" .)}}
{{end}}
{{$opts := dict "headers" $headers "key" $cacheKey}}
{{$githubRepoInfo := dict}}
{{with try (resources.GetRemote $url $opts)}}
  {{with .Err}}
    {{warnf "Failed to get GitHub repo info: %s" . | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
  {{else}}{{with (.Value | transform.Unmarshal)}}
    {{$githubRepoInfo = dict "html_url" .html_url "stargazers_url" .stargazers_url "watchers_count" .watchers_count "stargazers_count" .stargazers_count "forks_count" .forks_count "contributors_url" .contributors_url "releases_url" .releases_url "forks_count" .forks_count}}
  {{else}}
    {{errorf "Unable to get remote resource %q" $url | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
  {{end}}{{end}}
{{end}}

{{return $githubRepoInfo | _html_template_htmlescaper}}

### TEMPLATE "_partials/helpers/funcs/get-remote-data.html" 379

{{$url := .}}
{{$data := dict}}
{{with try (resources.GetRemote $url)}}
  {{with .Err}}
    {{errorf "%s" . | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
  {{else}}{{with .Value}}
    {{$data = .Content | transform.Unmarshal}}
  {{else}}
    {{errorf "Unable to get remote resource %q" $url | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
  {{end}}{{end}}
{{end}}
{{return $data | _html_template_htmlescaper}}

### TEMPLATE "_partials/helpers/gtag.html" 793
{{with site.Config.Services.GoogleAnalytics.ID}}
  <script
    async
    src="https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id={{. | _html_template_urlescaper | _html_template_attrescaper}}"></script>
<script>
  window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
  function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);}
  gtag('js', new Date());

  {{$site := site.BaseURL | replaceRE "^https?://(www\\.)?([^/]+).*" "$2"}}
  gtag('config', '{{. | _html_template_jsstrescaper}}', {'anonymize_ip': true, 'dimension1': '{{$site | _html_template_jsstrescaper}}', 'dimension2': '{{getenv "BRANCH" | _html_template_jsstrescaper}}'});



var trackOutboundLink = function(id, url) {
  gtag('event', 'click', {
    'event_category': 'outbound',
    'event_label': id,
    'transport_type': 'beacon'
  });
}

</script>
{{end}}

    srcset="{{$image.RelPermalink | _html_template_srcsetescaper | _html_template_attrescaper}}"

    height="{{$image1x.Height | _html_template_attrescaper}}">

### TEMPLATE "_partials/inline/h-rh-l/get-glossary-link-attributes.html" 1366
{{$contentPath := .contentPath}}{{$errorLevel := .errorLevel}}{{$renderHookName := .renderHookName}}{{$text := .text | transform.Plainify | strings.ToLower}}{{$glossaryPath := "/quick-reference/glossary"}}{{$termGiven := $text}}{{$termActual := ""}}{{$termSingular := inflect.Singularize $termGiven}}{{$glossaryPage := site.GetPage $glossaryPath}}{{if not $glossaryPage}}{{errorf "The %q render hook was unable to find %s: see %s" $renderHookName $glossaryPath $contentPath}}{{end}}{{$cheating := dict "chaining" "chain" "localize" "localization" "localized" "localization" "paginating" "paginate" "walking" "walk" "ci/cd" "cicd"}}{{if site.GetPage (urls.JoinPath $glossaryPath ($termGiven | urlize))}}{{$termActual = $termGiven}}{{else}}{{if site.GetPage (urls.JoinPath $glossaryPath ($termSingular | urlize))}}{{$termActual = $termSingular}}{{else}}{{$termToTest := index $cheating $termGiven}}{{if site.GetPage (urls.JoinPath $glossaryPath ($termToTest | urlize))}}{{$termActual = $termToTest}}{{end}}{{end}}{{end}}{{if not $termActual}}{{errorf "The %q render hook was unable to find a glossary page for either the singular or plural form of the term %q: see %s" $renderHookName $termGiven $contentPath}}{{end}}{{$href := ""}}{{if $termActual}}{{$href = fmt.Printf "%s#%s" $glossaryPage.RelPermalink (anchorize $termActual)}}{{end}}{{return (dict "href" $href)}}
### TEMPLATE "_partials/inline/h-rh-l/validate-fragment.html" 979

    {{with .RegularPages}}
        {{range $page := .ByTitle}}
          {{if or (and (eq $filterType "include") (in $filteredPages $page)) (and (eq $filterType "exclude") (not (in $filteredPages $page))) (eq $filterType "none")}}
            {{$linkTitle := .LinkTitle}}
            {{with $titlePrefix}}
              {{$linkTitle = printf "%s%s" . $linkTitle}}
            {{end}}
[{{$linkTitle | _html_template_htmlescaper}}]({{$page.RelPermalink | _html_template_htmlescaper}})
: {{$page.Description | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
          {{end}}
        {{end}}
    {{else}}
      {{warnf "The %q shortcode found no pages in the %q section. See %s" $.Name $sectionPath $.Position | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
    {{end}}
  {{else}}
    {{errorf "The %q shortcode was unable to find %q. See %s" $.Name $sectionPath $.Position | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
  {{end}}
{{else}}
  {{errorf "The %q shortcode requires a 'path' parameter indicating the path to the section. See %s" $.Name $.Position | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
{{end}}

### TEMPLATE "_partials/helpers/funcs/color-from-string.html" 724
{{$colors := slice "slate" "green" "cyan" "blue"}}
{{with .single}}
  {{$colors = slice .}}
{{end}}

{{$shades := slice 300 400 500}}
{{if not .dark}}
  {{$shades = slice 700 800}}
{{end}}
{{$hash := (hash.FNV32a .text)}}
{{$i := mod $hash (len $colors)}}
{{$j := mod $hash (len $shades)}}
{{$color := index $colors $i}}
{{$shade1 := index $shades $j}}
{{$shade2 := 0}}
{{$shade3 := 0}}
{{if gt $shade1 500}}
  {{$shade2 = math.Min (sub $shade1 500) 100 | int}}
  {{$shade3 = sub $shade1 100}}
{{else}}
  {{$shade2 = math.Max (add $shade1 500) 700 | int}}
  {{$shade3 = add $shade1 200}}
{{end}}
{{$res := dict "color" $color "shade1" $shade1 "shade2" $shade2 "shade3" $shade3}}
{{return $res | _html_template_htmlescaper}}

### TEMPLATE "_partials/helpers/funcs/get-github-info.html" 963
{{$url := "https://api.github.com/repos/gohugoio/hugo"}}
{{$cacheKey := print $url (now.Format "2006-01-02")}}
{{$headers := dict}}
{{with os.Getenv "HUGO_GH_TOKEN"}}
  {{$headers = dict "Authorization" (printf "Bearer %s" .)}}
{{end}}
{{$opts := dict "headers" $headers "key" $cacheKey}}
{{$githubRepoInfo := dict}}
{{with try (resources.GetRemote $url $opts)}}
  {{with .Err}}
    {{warnf "Failed to get GitHub repo info: %s" . | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
  {{else}}{{with (.Value | transform.Unmarshal)}}
    {{$githubRepoInfo = dict "html_url" .html_url "stargazers_url" .stargazers_url "watchers_count" .watchers_count "stargazers_count" .stargazers_count "forks_count" .forks_count "contributors_url" .contributors_url "releases_url" .releases_url "forks_count" .forks_count}}
  {{else}}
    {{errorf "Unable to get remote resource %q" $url | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
  {{end}}{{end}}
{{end}}

{{return $githubRepoInfo | _html_template_htmlescaper}}

### TEMPLATE "_partials/helpers/funcs/get-remote-data.html" 379

{{$url := .}}
{{$data := dict}}
{{with try (resources.GetRemote $url)}}
  {{with .Err}}
    {{errorf "%s" . | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
  {{else}}{{with .Value}}
    {{$data = .Content | transform.Unmarshal}}
  {{else}}
    {{errorf "Unable to get remote resource %q" $url | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
  {{end}}{{end}}

      {{with site.GetPage .}}
        {{$filteredPages = $filteredPages | append .}}

### TEMPLATE "_partials/helpers/funcs/color-from-string.html" 724
{{$colors := slice "slate" "green" "cyan" "blue"}}
{{with .single}}
  {{$colors = slice .}}
{{end}}

{{$shades := slice 300 400 500}}
{{if not .dark}}
  {{$shades = slice 700 800}}
{{end}}
{{$hash := (hash.FNV32a .text)}}
{{$i := mod $hash (len $colors)}}
{{$j := mod $hash (len $shades)}}
{{$color := index $colors $i}}
{{$shade1 := index $shades $j}}
{{$shade2 := 0}}
{{$shade3 := 0}}
{{if gt $shade1 500}}
  {{$shade2 = math.Min (sub $shade1 500) 100 | int}}
  {{$shade3 = sub $shade1 100}}
{{else}}
  {{$shade2 = math.Max (add $shade1 500) 700 | int}}
  {{$shade3 = add $shade1 200}}
{{end}}
{{$res := dict "color" $color "shade1" $shade1 "shade2" $shade2 "shade3" $shade3}}
{{return $res | _html_template_htmlescaper}}

### TEMPLATE "_partials/helpers/funcs/get-github-info.html" 963
{{$url := "https://api.github.com/repos/gohugoio/hugo"}}
{{$cacheKey := print $url (now.Format "2006-01-02")}}
{{$headers := dict}}
{{with os.Getenv "HUGO_GH_TOKEN"}}
  {{$headers = dict "Authorization" (printf "Bearer %s" .)}}
{{end}}
{{$opts := dict "headers" $headers "key" $cacheKey}}
{{$githubRepoInfo := dict}}
{{with try (resources.GetRemote $url $opts)}}
  {{with .Err}}
    {{warnf "Failed to get GitHub repo info: %s" . | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
  {{else}}{{with (.Value | transform.Unmarshal)}}
    {{$githubRepoInfo = dict "html_url" .html_url "stargazers_url" .stargazers_url "watchers_count" .watchers_count "stargazers_count" .stargazers_count "forks_count" .forks_count "contributors_url" .contributors_url "releases_url" .releases_url "forks_count" .forks_count}}
  {{else}}
    {{errorf "Unable to get remote resource %q" $url | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
  {{end}}{{end}}
{{end}}

{{return $githubRepoInfo | _html_template_htmlescaper}}

### TEMPLATE "_partials/helpers/funcs/get-remote-data.html" 379

{{$url := .}}
{{$data := dict}}
{{with try (resources.GetRemote $url)}}
  {{with .Err}}
    {{errorf "%s" . | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
  {{else}}{{with .Value}}
    {{$data = .Content | transform.Unmarshal}}
  {{else}}
    {{errorf "Unable to get remote resource %q" $url | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
  {{end}}{{end}}
{{end}}
{{return $data | _html_template_htmlescaper}}

### TEMPLATE "_shortcodes/list-pages-in-section.html" 1834



{{$filter := or "" (.Get "filter" | lower)}}
{{$filterType := or (.Get "filterType") "none" | lower}}
{{$filteredPages := slice}}
{{$titlePrefix := or (.Get "titlePrefix") ""}}


{{with $filter}}
  {{with index site.Data.page_filters .}}
    {{range .}}
      {{with site.GetPage .}}
        {{$filteredPages = $filteredPages | append .}}
      {{else}}
        {{errorf "The %q shortcode was unable to find %q as specified in the page_filters data file. See %s" $.Name . $.Position | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
      {{end}}
    {{end}}
  {{else}}
    {{errorf "The %q shortcode was unable to find the %q filter in the page_filters data file. See %s" $.Name . $.Position | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
  {{end}}
{{end}}


{{with $sectionPath := .Get "path"}}
  {{with site.GetPage .}}
    {{with .RegularPages}}
        {{range $page := .ByTitle}}
          {{if or (and (eq $filterType "include") (in $filteredPages $page)) (and (eq $filterType "exclude") (not (in $filteredPages $page))) (eq $filterType "none")}}
            {{$linkTitle := .LinkTitle}}
            {{with $titlePrefix}}
              {{$linkTitle = printf "%s%s" . $linkTitle}}
            {{end}}
[{{$linkTitle | _html_template_htmlescaper}}]({{$page.RelPermalink | _html_template_htmlescaper}})
: {{$page.Description | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
          {{end}}
        {{end}}
    {{else}}
      {{warnf "The %q shortcode found no pages in the %q section. See %s" $.Name $sectionPath $.Position | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
    {{end}}
  {{else}}
    {{errorf "The %q shortcode was unable to find %q. See %s" $.Name $sectionPath $.Position | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
  {{end}}
{{else}}
  {{errorf "The %q shortcode requires a 'path' parameter indicating the path to the section. See %s" $.Name $.Position | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
{{end}}

### TEMPLATE "_partials/helpers/funcs/color-from-string.html" 724
{{$colors := slice "slate" "green" "cyan" "blue"}}
{{with .single}}
  {{$colors = slice .}}
{{end}}

{{$shades := slice 300 400 500}}
{{if not .dark}}
  {{$shades = slice 700 800}}
{{end}}
{{$hash := (hash.FNV32a .text)}}
{{$i := mod $hash (len $colors)}}
{{$j := mod $hash (len $shades)}}
{{$color := index $colors $i}}
{{$shade1 := index $shades $j}}
{{$shade2 := 0}}
{{$shade3 := 0}}
{{if gt $shade1 500}}
  {{$shade2 = math.Min (sub $shade1 500) 100 | int}}
  {{$shade3 = sub $shade1 100}}
{{else}}
  {{$shade2 = math.Max (add $shade1 500) 700 | int}}
  {{$shade3 = add $shade1 200}}
{{end}}
{{$res := dict "color" $color "shade1" $shade1 "shade2" $shade2 "shade3" $shade3}}
{{return $res | _html_template_htmlescaper}}

{{end}}
{{$opts := dict "headers" $headers "key" $cacheKey}}

    {{warnf "Failed to get GitHub repo info: %s" . | _html_template_htmlescaper}}

    {{$githubRepoInfo = dict "html_url" .html_url "stargazers_url" .stargazers_url "watchers_count" .watchers_count "stargazers_count" .stargazers_count "forks_count" .forks_count "contributors_url" .contributors_url "releases_url" .releases_url "forks_count" .forks_count}}
  {{else}}
    {{errorf "Unable to get remote resource %q" $url | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
  {{end}}{{end}}
{{end}}

{{return $githubRepoInfo | _html_template_htmlescaper}}

        {{$filteredPages = $filteredPages | append .}}

  {{end}}

### TEMPLATE "_partials/helpers/funcs/color-from-string.html" 724
{{$colors := slice "slate" "green" "cyan" "blue"}}
{{with .single}}
  {{$colors = slice .}}
{{end}}

{{$shades := slice 300 400 500}}
{{if not .dark}}
  {{$shades = slice 700 800}}
{{end}}
{{$hash := (hash.FNV32a .text)}}
{{$i := mod $hash (len $colors)}}
{{$j := mod $hash (len $shades)}}
{{$color := index $colors $i}}
{{$shade1 := index $shades $j}}
{{$shade2 := 0}}
{{$shade3 := 0}}
{{if gt $shade1 500}}
  {{$shade2 = math.Min (sub $shade1 500) 100 | int}}
  {{$shade3 = sub $shade1 100}}
{{else}}
  {{$shade2 = math.Max (add $shade1 500) 700 | int}}
  {{$shade3 = add $shade1 200}}
{{end}}
{{$res := dict "color" $color "shade1" $shade1 "shade2" $shade2 "shade3" $shade3}}
{{return $res | _html_template_htmlescaper}}

### TEMPLATE "_partials/helpers/funcs/get-github-info.html" 963
{{$url := "https://api.github.com/repos/gohugoio/hugo"}}
{{$cacheKey := print $url (now.Format "2006-01-02")}}
{{$headers := dict}}
{{with os.Getenv "HUGO_GH_TOKEN"}}
  {{$headers = dict "Authorization" (printf "Bearer %s" .)}}
{{end}}
{{$opts := dict "headers" $headers "key" $cacheKey}}
{{$githubRepoInfo := dict}}
{{with try (resources.GetRemote $url $opts)}}
  {{with .Err}}
    {{warnf "Failed to get GitHub repo info: %s" . | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
  {{else}}{{with (.Value | transform.Unmarshal)}}
    {{$githubRepoInfo = dict "html_url" .html_url "stargazers_url" .stargazers_url "watchers_count" .watchers_count "stargazers_count" .stargazers_count "forks_count" .forks_count "contributors_url" .contributors_url "releases_url" .releases_url "forks_count" .forks_count}}
  {{else}}
    {{errorf "Unable to get remote resource %q" $url | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
  {{end}}{{end}}
{{end}}

{{return $githubRepoInfo | _html_template_htmlescaper}}

### TEMPLATE "_partials/helpers/funcs/get-remote-data.html" 379

{{$url := .}}
{{$data := dict}}
{{with try (resources.GetRemote $url)}}
  {{with .Err}}
    {{errorf "%s" . | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
  {{else}}{{with .Value}}
    {{$data = .Content | transform.Unmarshal}}
  {{else}}
    {{errorf "Unable to get remote resource %q" $url | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
  {{end}}{{end}}
{{end}}
{{return $data | _html_template_htmlescaper}}

{{end}}

### TEMPLATE "_shortcodes/list-pages-in-section.html" 1834



{{$filter := or "" (.Get "filter" | lower)}}
{{$filterType := or (.Get "filterType") "none" | lower}}
{{$filteredPages := slice}}
{{$titlePrefix := or (.Get "titlePrefix") ""}}


{{with $filter}}
  {{with index site.Data.page_filters .}}
    {{range .}}
      {{with site.GetPage .}}
        {{$filteredPages = $filteredPages | append .}}
      {{else}}
        {{errorf "The %q shortcode was unable to find %q as specified in the page_filters data file. See %s" $.Name . $.Position | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
      {{end}}
    {{end}}
  {{else}}
    {{errorf "The %q shortcode was unable to find the %q filter in the page_filters data file. See %s" $.Name . $.Position | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
  {{end}}
{{end}}


{{with $sectionPath := .Get "path"}}
  {{with site.GetPage .}}
    {{with .RegularPages}}
        {{range $page := .ByTitle}}
          {{if or (and (eq $filterType "include") (in $filteredPages $page)) (and (eq $filterType "exclude") (not (in $filteredPages $page))) (eq $filterType "none")}}
            {{$linkTitle := .LinkTitle}}
            {{with $titlePrefix}}
              {{$linkTitle = printf "%s%s" . $linkTitle}}
            {{end}}
[{{$linkTitle | _html_template_htmlescaper}}]({{$page.RelPermalink | _html_template_htmlescaper}})
: {{$page.Description | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
          {{end}}
        {{end}}
    {{else}}
      {{warnf "The %q shortcode found no pages in the %q section. See %s" $.Name $sectionPath $.Position | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
    {{end}}
  {{else}}
    {{errorf "The %q shortcode was unable to find %q. See %s" $.Name $sectionPath $.Position | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
  {{end}}
{{else}}
  {{errorf "The %q shortcode requires a 'path' parameter indicating the path to the section. See %s" $.Name $.Position | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
{{end}}

### TEMPLATE "render-toc-level" 1091

  {{range .h}}
    {{if and .ID (and (ge .Level 2) (le .Level 4))}}
      {{$indentation := "ml-0"}}
      {{if eq .Level 3}}
        {{$indentation = "ml-2 lg:ml-3"}}
      {{else}}{{if eq .Level 4}}
        {{$indentation = "ml-4 lg:ml-6"}}
      {{end}}{{end}}
      {{$.p.Store.Set "hasToc" true | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
      <li>
        <a
          href="#{{.ID | _html_template_urlescaper | _html_template_attrescaper}}"
          x-ref="{{.ID | _html_template_attrescaper}}"
          @click.stop="setActive('{{.ID | _html_template_attrescaper}}')"
          class="block pb-1 text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-500 dark:text-blue-500 dark:hover:text-blue-400 text-sm {{$indentation | _html_template_attrescaper}}"
          :class="{'font-bold dark:text-blue-200 dark:hover:text-blue-300' : activeHeading === '{{.ID | _html_template_attrescaper}}'}">
          {{.Title | safeHTML | _html_template_htmlescaper}}
        </a>
      </li>
    {{end}}
    {{with .Headings}}
      <ul>
        {{template "render-toc-level" (dict "h" . "p" $.p)}}

    {{end}}
